name: tokyocharterbus
description: Tokyo Charter Bus: charter coaches, minibuses and private cars with driver in and from Tokyo. Vehicle options, areas served, fare structure and written quote requests.

interface.shortDescription: Charter coaches and minibuses with driver in and from Tokyo
interface.longDescription: Connects to the public Tokyo Charter Bus MCP server (https://tokyocharterbus.com/mcp). Lists vehicle options, served areas and the fare structure, and can send a quote request to staff after the user confirms the details and agrees to the privacy policy. A quote request is never a booking; staff reply with a written quotation.
